free_text: The decision is to defer biopsy because the guideline criterion dictates deferral when the mpMRI shows a PI-RADS 2 finding. This aligns with the retrieved radiology report which explicitly stated 'No PI-RADS 3 or higher lesion identified.' Although the PSA trend was rising (0.31 ng/mL/yr), the PI-RADS 2 score, combined with the guideline, is decisive in supporting deferral.
